content:
Table staging.property_sales — Record-grain NSW residential sales. Physical table: staging.property_sales, matching raw.property_sales and marts.property_sales for easy lineage. One row per sale, cleaned and typed from raw.property_sales (dates parsed, postcode normalised, non-market transfers filtered, house/unit derived). This is the clean, verified mirror of raw.property_sales, kept as wide as relevant rather than a curated subset. Most questions are better answered by marts.property_sales (a precomputed aggregate) — use this table only when a question is genuinely about individual records or a metric the marts don't carry: "top 10 addresses by sale price in a suburb", "average price by lot size band", "list sales over $2M in a postcode". Always filter by postcode and/or sale_month first — this table is ~3M rows. Belongs to the `nsw_sales` dataset (RLS-scoped). Verified by the marts.property_sales dbt tests indirectly (built from this table).
Columns:
  sale_id — Surrogate key, unique per row (property_id alone isn't unique — split/fractional-interest sales share it).
  property_id — NSW Valuer-General property identifier. Not unique per row — see sale_id.
  suburb — Suburb name — a label, not the join key (postcode<->suburb is not 1:1 in this data).
  postcode — Postcode. Join key across sales/rent (with property_type and sale_month).
  property_type — 'house' or 'unit', derived from strata_no. Standardised identically to staging.property_rent.property_type so the two can be joined.
  sale_date — Full contract date.
  sale_year — Calendar year of sale_date.
  sale_month — First-of-month date, sale_date truncated to month. Join key across sales/rent (with postcode and property_type).
  sale_price — Sale price (AUD). Filtered to $10,000-$8,000,000 to exclude non-market transfers (see model SQL comments).
  area_sqm — Land/property area in square metres, STANDARDISED across units: source hectare values (area_type 'H') are converted to sqm (x10,000), metre values ('M') kept as-is. Null if missing, unparseable, or the unit is unknown — check area_band for a coarser, always-comparable cut.
  area_band — Standardised size band over area_sqm: '<400', '400-700', '700-1000', '1000-5000', or '5000+' sqm (5000+ is genuine large/rural land). Null when area_sqm is null. Use this instead of bucketing area_sqm yourself, so band boundaries stay consistent across questions.
  area_type — Source unit for the raw area: 'H' (hectares) or 'M' (square metres). area_sqm is already standardised to sqm using this.
  zoning — NSW planning zone code (e.g. R2, RU5, RU2) — lets you segment by land use, not just postcode.
  house_no — Street number, for record-level address lookups.
  street_name — Street name, for record-level address lookups.
  unit_no — Unit/lot number, where applicable.
  prop_name — Property name, where the source recorded one (usually blank for standard residential sales).
